variants.briefing:
Hi,

Someone knocked out one of our supply ships and towed it to [Location]. We really need the cargo onboard. You available to head over there and recover that cargo? 

Once you’ve got the goods, we need them taken to their original destination at [Destination]. Did a little digging into this group, and let’s just say, they don’t come off as very professional. Shouldn’t give you too much resistance, but still best to show up ready to throw down.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. 

Fly Safe, 

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
